responses: Hi! I'm the AG Parking assistant. Ask me about slot availability, bookings, cancellations, or your account.

Booking is always for right now — there's no advance/scheduled booking. Pick an available slot, then choose a saved vehicle or enter a new one, and book it immediately. It stays in "Booked" status for 1 hour — if you don't check in within that hour it auto-expires and the slot is released. You can only have one "Booked" reservation waiting for check-in at a time.

You can cancel a booking any time while it's still "Booked" (before check-in) from My Bookings → Cancel. Once it's "Active" (checked in), it can't be cancelled — you'll need to check out normally. There's no cancellation fee since payment only happens at checkout.

Check-in is done by staff at the check-in console using your booking ID or vehicle details — you don't check in yourself in the app. It moves your booking from "Booked" to "Active" and the slot from "Booked" to "Occupied". If your 1-hour window passes first, the booking auto-expires.

Check-out is done by staff when you're leaving. Billing is a minimum of 1 hour, rounded UP to the next hour, at the slot's hourly rate (rates vary by slot type). Check-out marks the booking "Completed", generates a receipt, and frees the slot back to Available.

You can save multiple vehicles under Profile → My Vehicles and pick one instantly when booking. Supported categories are 2 Wheeler, 3 Wheeler, and 4 Wheeler. If a vehicle has no plate yet, check "Registration Pending". You can also scan a plate photo (camera icon next to the registration field) to auto-fill the number. Saved vehicles can be edited or removed any time.

You can update your name/photo from Profile, change your password from Profile → Security, and change your email from Profile (this requires OTP verification of the new address). Accounts can be permanently deleted from Profile → Danger Zone by re-entering your password — this is irreversible.

When adding or booking a vehicle, tap the camera icon next to the registration field and take a clear, well-lit photo of the plate. The number is extracted automatically — you can still edit it if anything looks off.

At the check-in console, look up the user's pending "Booked" booking by booking ID or vehicle details, verify the vehicle matches, then confirm check-in. This moves the booking to "Active" and the slot to "Occupied".

At the check-out console, find the user's "Active" booking and confirm check-out. The system calculates the bill (minimum 1 hour, rounded up to the next hour at the slot's rate), marks the booking "Completed", generates a receipt, and frees the slot.

From the Admin dashboard you can add, edit, or deactivate parking slots — setting the slot type (standard/faculty/disabled/ev), location, and hourly rate. Deactivated slots stop appearing as bookable but keep their history.
From the Admin dashboard you can change a user's role between user/staff/admin (this moves them between the Users and Staff sections automatically) and activate or deactivate accounts.
